foundAndRepaired.finding: The reused signing setup and recovery initially read or replaced the user search list.
foundAndRepaired.repairReviewed: Preflight skips search-list reads, sets and restores; owned recovery records and validates mode and restore scope. Legacy mode behavior remains separate.

foundAndRepaired.finding: A late ownership-unlink failure initially changed only memory after a PASS artifact had been written.
foundAndRepaired.repairReviewed: Cleanup determines ownership-unlink outcome before persisting; main persists final FAIL after late or unexpected cleanup failure. Final receipt-write failure returns nonzero and attempts removal of a stale receipt.

foundAndRepaired.finding: Direct cleanup tools initially lacked a timeout, and already-removed owned temporary state could make recovery fail again.
foundAndRepaired.repairReviewed: Preflight and its recovery use 60-second security-command bounds, handle timeout or OS failure and continue owned temporary deletion. Already-missing owned temporary/keychain state is idempotent; recovered cleanup does not rewrite an earlier failure receipt.

foundAndRepaired.finding: The inherited substring check could match the expected fingerprint inside another certificate subject.
foundAndRepaired.repairReviewed: Preflight requires exactly one anchored find-identity entry whose actual fingerprint field matches the profile certificate. A subject containing the expected fingerprint is rejected by the reviewed regression source.

confirmedSourceGuards.appleTransport: Fixed HTTPS App Store Connect host; three exact app/group/latest-build GET route shapes; request bodies rejected before authentication; redirects denied; 45-second socket timeout and 2,000,000-byte response cap.
confirmedSourceGuards.signingMaterial: Profile team, bundle, distribution, NFC, expiry and sole certificate checks; certificate dates, team OU and distribution CN; exact private-key identity entry; P-256 App Store Connect key.
confirmedSourceGuards.association: Configured app ID and exact bundle record, exact internal-group ID and app relationship, and allowlisted latest-build metadata.
confirmedSourceGuards.distributionDenial: Preflight rejects profile-install, archive, export/upload, processing/attachment entrypoints; no project generation, IPA publication or build-number reservation.
confirmedSourceGuards.credentialHandling: Owned private temporary files/keychain; captured private tool output; fixed sanitized error labels; no private material intentionally copied to preflight public logs/artifacts. Existing security CLI password-argument design is retained only for the trusted ephemeral runner.
confirmedSourceGuards.cleanup: Owned path and mode bounds, no preflight user-profile cleanup scope, bounded command failures, final failure persistence, and mandatory always-cleanup workflow step.
confirmedSourceGuards.workflow: Separate 15-minute preflight job in the existing credential-governed environment; exact candidate checkout; unsigned job has no secret environment; only preflight receipt.json is selected for publication.
confirmedSourceGuards.compatibility: Existing unsigned, upload and observe job selection and their distribution paths are retained; read-only preflight is a distinct mode.
confirmedSourceGuards.packetLimits: GET success is explicitly separate from upload rights, revocation, Apple acceptance, build-number availability, physical installation and physical AR.

limits: READY is an independent code-review conclusion, not candidate qualification, execution authorization or product acceptance.
Actual credential validity, Apple app/group access, environment protection and cleanup on a real macOS runner were not exercised by this reviewer.
No upload right, certificate/profile revocation result, future build-number reservation, Apple acceptance, physical installation or AR result is inferred.
Host I/O failures can prevent writing or deleting a receipt; final write failure remains nonzero and stale-file deletion is best effort, never an unconditional host-storage guarantee.
Windows byte hashes bind this reviewed uncommitted snapshot; the parent must separately bind committed Git blobs before execution. Builder tests remain separate evidence.

primaryReferenceConsulted.scope: Current Apple source excludes ordinary private keychains from automatic search-list insertion; this supports source review, not an actual host-state measurement.
